base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y python3.11-venv 2>/dev/null || apt-get install -y python3-venv
setup_runtime_commands: cd /workspace/Python/libraries/resource-generator && python index.py ../recognizers-choice/resource-definitions.json && python index.py ../recognizers-number/resource-definitions.json && python index.py ../recognizers-number-with-unit/resource-definitions.json && python index.py ../recognizers-date-time/resource-definitions.json && python index.py ../recognizers-sequence/resource-definitions.json

cd /workspace/Python && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-text/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-number/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-number-with-unit/ && pip install -e ./libraries/datatypes-timex-expression/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-date-time/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-sequence/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-choice/ && pip install -e ./libraries/recognizers-suite/

runtime_profile.notes: Python virtualenv-based environment with all Microsoft Recognizers Text libraries installed in editable mode. Resources are generated from YAML pattern definitions before library installation.

notes: Base image should be Debian Bookworm or similar. Git and curl are pre-installed in the base image. Python 3.11 with venv support is required. The environment uses a system-wide virtual environment at /opt/benchmark/venv for the Python implementation. Node.js is available for JavaScript platform support but not actively configured for testing. The .NET SDK and Java/Maven are not included in this environment as Python is the primary test platform. MOUNT REQUIREMENT: The /tests/ directory is created in setup_runtime.sh to provide a mount point for the outer verifier. OUTER VERIFIER READINESS: The eval.sh script at /artifacts/evaluation/eval.sh is designed to be mounted at /tests/eval.sh inside the container. The activation command 'source /opt/benchmark/venv/bin/activate' is embedded in eval.sh and will work correctly when the outer verifier mounts /artifacts/evaluation/ as /tests/. The /tests directory now exists in the image to support the mount operation.
